title: Progress Check 1 · Weeks 1–4
subtitle: 20 marks · no help · 20 minutes

sections.title: A. Complete the sentences (10 marks)
items: 1) If I ___ (know) about the party, I would have come.
2) If she had taken the job, she ___ (live) in Dubai now.
3) You won't pass ___ you study harder.
4) I wish I ___ (not say) that yesterday.
5) I wish I ___ (can) speak Chinese.
6) The streets are wet. It ___ (must / rain) last night.
7) You ___ (should / tell) me earlier!
8) She ___ (can't / see) me — she was in Aswan that day.
9) You can use my laptop as ___ as you're careful with it.
10) If we hadn't hesitated, we ___ (not miss) the chance.
answers: 8) can't have seen / couldn't have seen

sections.title: B. Translate into English (5 marks)
items: 1) لو كنت ذاكرت أكثر، لكنت نجحت.
2) ليتني لم أشارك ذلك الخبر الكاذب.
3) لا بد أنه كان متوترًا جدًا.
4) سأساعدك بشرط أن تقول الحقيقة.
5) كان بإمكاننا أن نأخذ تاكسي.
answers: 1) If I had studied more, I would have passed. / If I had studied harder, I would have passed.
2) I wish I hadn't shared that fake news.
3) He must have been very stressed (out). / He must have been very nervous.
4) I'll help you provided that (as long as) you tell the truth.
5) We could have taken a taxi. / We could have got a taxi.

sections.title: C. Write the Arabic meaning (5 marks)
items: 1) in hindsight = __________
answers: 1) بالنظر إلى ما حدث / بعد فوات الأوان

sections.title: D. Speaking check — tick what you can do
items: ☐ I can talk about a past decision and imagine a different result.
☐ I can give advice and set conditions with unless and as long as.
☐ I can talk about my online habits, my wishes and my regrets.
☐ I can guess what happened and criticise past actions politely.

score: My score: ______ / 20   18–20 Excellent · 16–17 Very good · under 16: repeat the sentences of these weeks for 3 days, then try again.
